messages: alex: FYI opened PR #789 to fix broken anchors discovered by linkcheck in the Vercel preview. some internal cross-doc links jump to top of page instead of the heading. anyone seen this before? priya: pinging — Vercel previews sometimes rewrite hashes when `use_directory_urls: true` is set. can you share the failing link? alex: example: /docs/guides/migrations/#upgrading-the-sdk -> preview goes to /docs/guides/migrations/ and not the fragment. locally it works with mkdocs serve. docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #789 finished (status: success). linkcheck reported 12 warnings, 3 errors. charles: linkcheck errors could be from our mkdocs-linkcheck plugin treating internal anchors strictly. did the migration headings change from H2 to H3? that would shift the slug. melissa: also check for unicode or smart quotes in the heading text — slug generation differs between local OS renders and the build image. normalize headings to ASCII for deterministic slugs. ryan: if you want a quick workaround add explicit anchor tags: `` above the heading. Not ideal but will make the fragment stable across builds. alex: good tip. I can add explicit anchors for the problematic sections and add a unit to avoid regressions. priya: for approving — CI pipeline includes `docs-linkcheck` job. once linkcheck is green I can approve. Are we holding this for the normal docs merge window (13:00-14:00 UTC)? charles: yes let's queue for the 13:00 slot so we avoid stomping other previews. if it's green by 12:50 I'll mark for merge. alex: I added explicit anchors and updated the failing cross-links to the canonical slug (lowercase, dashes). pushed. docs-bot: CI started for PR #789: jobs started: lint, build, linkcheck, preview. melissa: small note — our linkcheck configuration ignores anchors by default unless `strict_anchors: true` is set. enabling strict_anchors found these regressions; good to keep enabled but we should document the slug rules in CONTRIBUTING. ryan: added a tiny CONTRIBUTING section suggestion: slug generation rules, prefer ascii headings, avoid starting headings with emoji. priya: linkcheck job passed on the latest run, preview shows anchors working. docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #789 updated (status: success). linkcheck: 0 errors. charles: I'll do a quick content pass for style/clarity. if no changes I'll approve and schedule merge at 13:00 UTC. alex: thanks — also added a tiny integration test in the docs CI that curls `/docs/guides/migrations/#upgrading-the-sdk` and asserts 200 and presence of heading text. priya: thanks for adding the test. that will catch regressions when we rename sections. melissa: after merge, can ops invalidate the docs CDN cache? sometimes previews and prod cache mismatches cause users to see stale anchors. ryan: noted — ops will run cache purge after the merge. charles: approved. tagging for 13:00 merge window. :white_check_mark: alex: awesome, thanks everyone :)
